messages:
adele: FYI e2e perf smoke gate failed on nightly for PR #4821 — p95 is +22% vs baseline (us-west canary). linking logs: https://ci.redwood/integration/4821/job/101 :eyes:
parth: looking now, thanks. any diffs in model config?
mike: when did baseline last change?
adele: no model changes in the PR, it's a runtime-only change (allocator tweaks). baseline updated last night from canary run.
runtime-qa: I can kick a rerun on the nightly job. anyone want a bisect instead?
jali: please rerun first, sometimes transient infra noise. I'll request a bisect if rerun reproduces.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: job 101 -> rerun 102 (requested by runtime-qa) :white_check_mark:
adele: pasted relevant lines from the perf log:
```
[2026-03-16 02:03:12] model: gpt-13b, seq=1024
p95_latency_ms: baseline=122.4 current=149.3 delta=+26.9
throughput_tok/s: baseline=1850 current=1680 delta=-9.2%
KV_cache_hit: 0.86 -> 0.63
```
parth: KV cache hit drop looks suspicious. recent allocator change could increase memory churn and evictions.
mike: if KV cache hit drops that's consistent with eviction/ordering regressions. can you repro locally with small scale?
adele: I'm going to run a minimal reproducer on a single GPU with seq=1024 and the same model. ETA ~15m.
runtime-qa: rerun finished: job 102 -> failed gate p95 +24% (same pattern). CI log: https://ci.redwood/integration/4821/job/102/log
jali: okay bisect time. propose range: commit 9d3f7a2..ae12c4b (last good is 9d3f7a2). can someone confirm that's safe to bisect?
parth: confirmed range looks right. I'll start a bisect workflow that runs a lightweight e2e variant (seq=512, tokens=256) to speed up. if we see regression there, escalate to full nightly.
ci-bot: Bisect started: bisect-id=3501, runner=parth, commits=23
mike: also try forcing KV cache disabled to confirm hypothesis: set ENV KV_CACHE_ENABLED=0 for a quick run. if perf returns to baseline, we know it's eviction-related.
adele: tried KV_CACHE_ENABLED=0 locally — p95 back to 125ms, throughput back within 3% of baseline. side-by-side indicates KV cache behavior is the trigger. :thumbsup:
runtime-oncall: good repro. if bisect finds a kernel/memory allocator change, we should hotfix revert and then follow-up with a deeper allocator fix.
parth: bisect update: narrowed to commit ae12c4b -> be814f0 (two commits). running final candidates now.
ci-bot: bisect finished: culprit commit = be814f0 (memory pool free-list change) :warning:
mike: nice catch. that commit refactors free-list batching — likely increasing fragmentation under long sequences.
jali: opening an emergency revert PR now and tagging release owners. PR draft: https://git.redwood/reverts/revert-be814f0
adele: once revert lands, can we run an immediate canary? runtime-qa can you queue canary run on us-west?
runtime-qa: on it — canary queued (job 110).
ci-bot: canary job 110 -> passed perf gate p95 within 1% of baseline.
adele: great. thanks everyone for the quick triage. follow-ups: (1) add targeted perf test for long-seq KV behavior to the e2e suite, (2) track allocator fragmentation in metrics dashboard. I'll create issues.
parth: adding note to PR checklist: "run seq=1024 perf smoke on runtime changes".
mike: thanks. moving to postmortem channel to write a short blameless note. :handshake:
adele: closing thread — feel free to ping if any regressions reappear.
